hints.title: Using AtomicReference
hints.content: Declare `AtomicReference<Double> cachedPower = new AtomicReference<>(0.0);`. Write with `cachedPower.set(0.75)` and read with `cachedPower.get()`.

hints.title: Waiting for the thread to finish
hints.content: Call `thread.join()` after starting it to block the main thread until the background thread completes. This ensures the cached values are ready before you read them.

hints.title: Setting motor power from the cache
hints.content: After join(), read the cached value: `double power = cachedPower.get();` then `motor.setPower(power);`
